repairs-20261102.context: Create Sky 0.1.31 with uncommitted resource repairs; Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.264. lantern-hanging-20261103.context: Isolated Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.264; shaders off, noon. Approved sloped hanging appearance; flat bridge restored to its regular standing lantern. Native interaction bounds remain pending.

window-boundaries-20261103.context: Minecraft 1.21.1 / NeoForge 21.1.264, Fusion 1.3.16, shaders off. Matched native control, old unconditional workaround and conditional added-face prototype. The prototype restores native base models; only the three Create framed-glass variants receive conditional faces. Added-face CT remains unresolved.
